item.title: ‘If death is my destiny’: Sheikh Hasina firm on returning to Bangladesh in December
item.description: Sheikh Hasina has confirmed her intention to return to Bangladesh, despite facing a death sentence. The former Prime Minister is aware of the risks associated with her return, including potential arrest or worse. Hasina's Awami League party has been banned, resulting in widespread political repression and violence against its members. She expressed concerns over the rising influence of extremist groups in the current political climate. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Titanic's owners received $5 million within 30 days of the sinking; 114 years later, original insurance certificate resurfaces and could sell for $67,000
item.description: An authentic insurance document related to the Titanic's last journey is slated for auction in Britain. This significant paperwork details the insurance sought mere weeks before the 1912 sinking. The owners received their payout shortly after the tragedy, contrasting sharply with the delays faced by bereaved families. The piece also underscores the important insurance arrangements for the Titanic, along with a selection of other artifacts that commemorate its storied past. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: La ola azul en EE. UU.: demócratas recuperan Congreso y gobernaciones clave
item.description: Los demócratas lograron una amplia victoria en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de EE. UU., recuperando el control tanto de la Cámara de Representantes como del Senado. Entre los triunfos más destacados figuran los de James Talarico en Texas, Annie Andrews en Carolina del Sur y Abdul El-Sayed en Michigan. La ola azul también alcanzó las gobernaciones, con la victoria de Gina Hinojosa en Texas frente a Greg Abbott. Analizamos las claves de unos comicios que reconfiguran el equilibrio de poder en Washington y representan un importante revés para la agenda de Donald Trump. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Asian-American voters, younger turnout fuel blue wave for Democrats in midterms
item.description: Democrats scored a sweeping victory in Tuesday’s midterm elections, with Asian-Americans and other voters of colour playing a key role, according to a new voter poll released on Wednesday. The 2026 Midterm Election Voter Poll surveyed 10,141 voters, including 2,130 Asian-American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) voters, between October 20 and November 3. It offers insights into voting trends across racial groups. Taeku Lee, a Harvard professor of government and a researcher for the poll, said... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Netanyahu claims 'serious concerns' of foreign spending to sway Israeli election
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday cited "serious suspicions" around foreign interference in Israel's recent parliamentary elections. He claims foreign countries spent large amounts of money to influence the results, while the largest Arab-Israeli bloc called such accusations "political persecution". Fuente: France 24 - English.
